status: PROPOSED — requires independent review; not frozen
rule: Every BROKER_ORDER_FIELD sink of the frozen Gate 2.2 artifact must name its successor in the frozen Signal Authority Architecture v1.0.2. REPLACE: becomes a field of the named Gate-4 object. PROVENANCE: moves to contract/manifest identity and leaves the order. REMOVE: permission or admission data that must not ride in an order; replaced by the named verdict. AUDIT: ledgered, excluded from identity. BROKER_ORDER_PAYLOAD stays LEGACY_REMOVE only while every one of its fields has an entry here.

makeIntent.schema.note: Wire-format label; not an authority input.

makeIntent.engineVersion.note: A version string is not a content hash; Gate 4 binds the running core by hash.

makeIntent.eventId.note: CONFLICT WITH OA-1/H-5B: built in checkSig as [k,profileId,triggerAt,Math.round(now)] — the wall-clock term makes it non-deterministic, so it cannot serve as the identity preimage OA-3 relies on.

makeIntent.createdAt.successor: EntryIntent (§10.3 constructEntry).constructedAt (audit-only, excluded from identity per H-5B)

makeIntent.signalAt.successor: FIRE event time (§4.4) carried via fireEventId
makeIntent.signalAt.note: Not a field of EntryIntent; the FIRE event owns it.

makeIntent.profileId.note: Profile selection is upstream authority; it must not ride in the order as an input.

makeIntent.exitPolicy.note: Literal AUTO stands in for a hash-bound Position Management Policy.

makeIntent.accountProvider.note: A provider label is not an account identity.

makeIntent.strategyModelId.note: Model identity is Layer 2A/3 provenance, not an order field.

makeIntent.instrumentKey.successor: instrument via EntryIntent (§10.3 constructEntry).geometryId (FrozenTradeGeometry §6.7) and brokerSymbolConstraints (§10.1)

makeIntent.dataQuality.note: Data health decides admission upstream; a status string in the order is not authority.

makeIntent.entry.note: EntryIntent carries no entry price; pExec is the ExecutionSnapshot basis (X-7).

makeIntent.takeProfit.note: Today a single target (t1 fallback); the successor carries t1..t3.

makeIntent.riskFraction.successor: EntryIntent (§10.3 constructEntry).size, computed under riskSizingPolicyHash from RiskContextSnapshot (§10.1, §7.8)
makeIntent.riskFraction.note: Today a fraction with a hard-coded .0025 default is sent and size is computed server-side, outside this artifact. The default is a capital threshold with no recorded provenance (HP-3 worksheet).

makeIntent.riskScale.successor: input to size under Risk/Sizing Policy (§7.8)
makeIntent.riskScale.note: Must not be a separate order field.

makeIntent.tradePermission.note: Set to DEMO_ELIGIBLE as a literal in checkSig.

makeIntent.calibrationOk.note: A live calibrationAudit() call in the order builder.

routeConfirmedReversal.intent.eventId.note: Built as [EXIT,positionId,candidate.id,triggerAt] — deterministic, consistent with PMA-7.

routeConfirmedReversal.intent.dataExecut.successor: RISK_REDUCING classification by economic effect (§10.11 OC-2/OC-3)
routeConfirmedReversal.intent.dataExecut.note: Literal true spoofs data health (already inventoried as RISK_REDUCING_DATA_BYPASS).

routeConfirmedReversal.intent.exitSide.successor: ManagementIntent (§10.5 constructManagement).actionType / requestedClose (§10.5); classified RISK_REDUCING by effect (PMA-2)
routeConfirmedReversal.intent.exitSide.note: PMA-4: a reversal is two acts — this path may only close; an opposite entry needs a new FIRE.

routeConfirmedReversal.intent.reason.note: OC-3: classification is computed from economic effect, never from a label.

routeConfirmedReversal.intent.candidateI.successor: source candidate of the management trigger (Position Management Policy input, §7.9)

routeConfirmedReversal.intent.triggerAt.successor: source-bar time in the trigger observation (H-5A)

closePosition.positionId.successor: full close by verified position ID (§10.5 PMA-6, SB-17)
